name: Senti Metrica
source:
The protagonist was once an ordinary college student.

Until one day, she realizes that her body is slowly turning into a "monster."

Recurring nightmares.

A mysterious voice that calls out to her from within those dreams.

And then, an encounter with those who hunt monsters, known as "Metrica."

The moment her true nature is discovered, only one fate awaits her—

Death.

As her everyday life begins to crumble,band the boundary between worlds collapses, she moves closer to uncovering the truth.

[Taken from Steam]
